Short title extent and commencement

THE CONTINUANCE OF LEGAL PROCEEDINGS ACT, 1950
THE CONTINUANCE OF LEGAL PROCEEDINGS ACT, 1950
ACT No. XI of 1950
[23rd January, 1950]
An Act to provide for the continuance of certain legal proceedings by
or against the Secretary of State
1. Short title extent and commencement.‑(1) This Act may be called
the Continuance of Legal Proceedings Act, 1950.
(Subs. by the Central Laws (Statute Reform)
Ordinance, 1960 (21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd Sch., for the original sub‑section
(2) (with effect from the 14th October, 1955).)[(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.]
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Interpretation

THE CONTINUANCE OF LEGAL PROCEEDINGS ACT, 1950
THE CONTINUANCE OF LEGAL PROCEEDINGS ACT, 1950
ACT No. XI of 1950
[23rd January, 1950]
An Act to provide for the continuance of certain legal proceedings by
or against the Secretary of State
2. Interpretation. In this Act "the appointed day" means
the fifteenth day of August, 1947, and "the Act" means the Indian
Independence Act, 1947, 10 & 11 Geo. 6, c. 30.

Continuance of legal proceedings

THE CONTINUANCE OF LEGAL PROCEEDINGS ACT, 1950
THE CONTINUANCE OF LEGAL PROCEEDINGS ACT, 1950
ACT No. XI of 1950
[23rd January, 1950]
An Act to provide for the continuance of certain legal proceedings by
or against the Secretary of State
3. Continuance of legal proceedings. Any legal proceedings by or
against the Secretary of State which immediately before the appointed day were
pending in any court within the territories which, as from the appointed day,
became the territories of Pakistan by virtue of sub‑section (2) of
section 2 of the Act and were in respect of any right in Pakistan or any part
thereof shall‑
(Subs. by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch., for
the original clauses (i), (ii) and (iii) (with effect from the 23rd March,
1956).) [(i) if the right in
question was that of the Governor- General‑in‑Council, be continued
by or against Pakistan;
(ii) if the right in question was
that of East Bengal, be continued by or against East Pakistan; and
(Subs. by A. O.,1964, Art. 2 and Sch., for
the existing clause (iii).)[(iii)
if the right in question was that of the Punjab, Sind, North‑West
Frontier, Baluchistan or the Karachi Division be continued by or against West
Pakistan.] ]
(The original clause (iv) omitted ibid.)* * * * *

Exclusion of time in computing period of limitation

THE CONTINUANCE OF LEGAL PROCEEDINGS ACT, 1950
THE CONTINUANCE OF LEGAL PROCEEDINGS ACT, 1950
ACT No. XI of 1950
[23rd January, 1950]
An Act to provide for the continuance of certain legal proceedings by
or against the Secretary of State
4. Exclusion of time in computing period of limitation. In computing
the period of limitation prescribed for any appeal or application to a court in
respect of any such proceedings as aforesaid, the period from the appointed day
to the commencement of this Act shall be excluded.
